mapper.select: SELECT * FROM voice_room WHERE id=#{room} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM voice_room_member WHERE room_id=#{room} AND user_id=#{user} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM voice_room_member WHERE room_id=#{room} AND member_state='ACTIVE' ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM voice_room_member WHERE room_id=#{room} AND room_role='ADMIN' ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 9 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM voice_seat WHERE room_id=#{room} ORDER BY seat_no LIMIT 9 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM voice_seat_request WHERE room_id=#{room} AND request_state='PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT 9 FOR UPDATE
SELECT fingerprint,command_type,result_version,result_session_id FROM voice_command_receipt WHERE room_id=#{room} AND user_id=#{user} AND request_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_id FROM voice_command_receipt WHERE room_id=#{room} AND user_id=#{user} AND created_at>=#{since} LIMIT 11 FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_id FROM voice_command_receipt WHERE room_id=#{room} AND user_id=#{user} LIMIT 1001 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voice_room_member(room_id,user_id,display_name,room_role,member_state,session_id,lease_until,joined_at) VALUES(#{member.roomId},#{member.userId},#{member.displayName},#{member.roomRole},'ACTIVE',#{member.sessionId},#{member.leaseUntil},#{joined}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name=VALUES(display_name),room_role=VALUES(room_role),member_state='ACTIVE',session_id=VALUES(session_id),lease_until=VALUES(lease_until),joined_at=VALUES(joined_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE voice_seat SET seat_state=#{seat.seatState},user_id=#{seat.userId},session_id=#{seat.sessionId},request_id=#{seat.requestId},muted=#{seat.muted} WHERE room_id=#{seat.roomId} AND seat_no=#{seat.seatNo}
UPDATE voice_seat_request SET request_state=#{state} WHERE id=#{id} AND request_state='PENDING'
UPDATE voice_room_member SET lease_until=#{until} WHERE room_id=#{room} AND user_id=#{user} AND session_id=#{session} AND member_state='ACTIVE' AND lease_until>#{now}
UPDATE voice_room_member SET member_state=#{state} WHERE room_id=#{room} AND user_id=#{user} AND member_state='ACTIVE'
UPDATE voice_room_member SET room_role=#{role} WHERE room_id=#{room} AND user_id=#{user}
UPDATE voice_room SET owner_id=#{target.userId},owner_name=#{target.displayName} WHERE id=#{room} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND status='OPEN'
UPDATE voice_room SET interaction_version=interaction_version+1 WHERE id=#{room} AND interaction_version<9223372036854775807
